title: Keyboard Manager captures keys which it should not
author: dotriz

status.label: Needs current desktop-shortcut repro
status.detail: The v0.70.1 report is specific, but current main has an exact-match guard for extra held keys. Confirm the current build and the exact remap before deciding whether a separate input path still captures Win+Ctrl+Arrow.

next_action: Ask whether the virtual-desktop shortcut still fails on a current build and confirm the exact remap rows and disabled-remap control result.

judgment.rationale: The reporter says Ctrl+Left and Ctrl+Right remappings capture Win+Ctrl+Left/Right, preventing virtual-desktop switching. The report is from PowerToys 0.70.1 and has no follow-up. Current main's shortcut handler checks exact-match shortcuts against other held keys before consuming the action key, so a present-day result and the exact mapping are needed to distinguish a remaining defect from a stale or different remap path.
evidence: Issue #27021 is open, unassigned, labeled Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, and Product-Keyboard Manager, and has no comments; its 2026-10-11 update changed labels only.
The report lists PowerToys 0.70.1 and says Ctrl+Left/Right mappings capture Win+Ctrl+Left/Right instead of allowing Windows virtual-desktop switching.
At upstream main 0b1dd814878f0dfbb07787d9c3e52a2897b6f769, KeyboardEventHandlers.cpp:684-686 checks exact-match shortcuts against other held keys before consuming the action key.
No linked pull request or duplicate covering this report was found.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the current-version result, the configured destinations, and a control test with Keyboard Manager disabled before designing a code change.

fix_assessment.rationale: A remap interception defect remains plausible if Windows' Win+Ctrl+Arrow chord is still consumed on a current build, but the report predates the current exact-match guard and does not identify the remap targets.

issue_context.summary: Ctrl+Left/Right remappings reportedly prevent the native Win+Ctrl+Left/Right virtual-desktop shortcuts from working.
known_information: The original report lists PowerToys 0.70.1, installed from the Microsoft Store and running as administrator.
The reporter says the configured source shortcuts are Ctrl+Left Arrow and Ctrl+Right Arrow and that Windows' Win+Ctrl+Left/Right desktop-switching shortcuts are captured.
The issue has no comments or assignee; the latest upstream activity was a label-only update on 2026-10-11.
Current main has an exact-match check in the shortcut-remap handler that accounts for other held keys.
inferences: If the issue still reproduces, either the remap's matching path is not using the exact-match guard or the additional Win modifier is not being observed as expected.
A current-build test with the remap disabled would establish whether the same desktop shortcut works outside Keyboard Manager.
issue_context.analysis: The reported behavior is a concrete conflict between a configured Ctrl+Arrow remap and the native Win+Ctrl+Arrow chord. The current source already contains an exact-match check, so do not propose changing shortcut matching until the reporter confirms the behavior on a current build and provides the configured target rows. The original issue does not include those targets or a current-version test.
initial_investigation: Read the live issue body, labels, assignees, comments, and timeline through 2026-10-11T16:48:52Z; there are no comments, assignees, or direct linked pull requests.

information_gaps.information: Whether Win+Ctrl+Left/Right is still captured on a current PowerToys build, and the exact PowerToys version tested.
information_gaps.why_needed: The only supplied reproduction is from v0.70.1, while current main has an exact-match guard that may change the result.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retest the same desktop-switch shortcut on the latest installed stable build and include its version.

information_gaps.information: The configured destination for each Ctrl+Left/Right remap and whether those rows are shortcut remaps or key remaps.
information_gaps.why_needed: The current handler's exact-match behavior applies to shortcut matching; the configured mapping type and target identify the path that must be traced.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with the two rows as displayed in Keyboard Manager; no new screenshot is needed unless the rows cannot be described.

information_gaps.information: Whether Win+Ctrl+Left/Right works with Keyboard Manager disabled under the same Windows session.
information_gaps.why_needed: This control separates a Keyboard Manager interception from a Windows or environment-level shortcut failure.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Temporarily disable Keyboard Manager, repeat the same Win+Ctrl+Arrow shortcut, and report whether the virtual desktop changes.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve native Win+Ctrl+Arrow desktop shortcuts
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: a remap path may consume Ctrl+Left/Right even when the additional Win modifier makes the event a different native shortcut. Current main has an exact-match guard, so this hypothesis is not confirmed without a current reproduction.
plan: Confirm the current PowerToys version, the two remap targets and mapping type, and whether the native shortcut works with Keyboard Manager disabled.
If the current build still consumes the native chord, trace the configured mapping through HandleShortcutRemapEvent and identify why the Win modifier is not excluded by the exact-match check.
Make the smallest correction that lets unmatched Win+Ctrl+Arrow input reach Windows, and add regression coverage for both remapped Ctrl+Arrow and native Win+Ctrl+Arrow behavior.
verification: Ctrl+Left/Right still invokes the configured remaps.
Win+Ctrl+Left/Right switches virtual desktops with the remaps enabled.
The desktop-switch result matches the control run with Keyboard Manager disabled.

confidence.rationale: The original symptom is clear, but it is from v0.70.1 and current main already has an extra-held-key guard; the exact remap targets and a current control result are missing.

actions.label: Approve desktop-shortcut investigation
actions.note: Proceed to a code design only if the current-build control confirms that Keyboard Manager still captures Win+Ctrl+Arrow.

actions.label: Request current shortcut result and remap rows

comment.body:
Thanks for documenting the Ctrl+Left/Right mappings and the affected Win+Ctrl+Arrow virtual-desktop shortcuts. The report is from PowerToys 0.70.1, and current Keyboard Manager code has an exact-match check, so could you confirm:
- Whether this still happens on a current PowerToys build (please include its version) and what destination each Ctrl+Arrow row uses.
- Whether the same Win+Ctrl+Left/Right shortcut works with Keyboard Manager disabled in the same Windows session.

You do not need to upload files for these checks.
